item.title: Confirmed appointments come with a reminder
item.summary: When a future care appointment is confirmed in a private conversation, Murph now creates one useful reminder by default unless you opt out.
item.details: Morning appointments use the prior evening, later appointments use the same morning, and Murph keeps the same reminder up to date when an appointment is rescheduled or canceled.

tryIt.label: Tell Murph about an appointment
tryIt.prompt: I have a confirmed dentist appointment next Thursday at 2 PM.
